title: Quantum dynamics tailored to observables and Hamiltonian scales
summary: Observable-specific stochastic sampling and norm-aware deterministic splitting target different errors. Exact one-qubit calculations compare order, bias, variance and exponential counts, including a distribution that improves one observable while worsening another.
